name: mnist-small-conv-neural-impurity-tree

protocol.command: caffeinate -i uv run python scripts/analysis/train_impurity_convnet.py --criteria gini,entropy,cross_entropy --epochs 20 --batch-size 1024 --learning-rate 0.001 --weight-decay 0.0001 --depth 4 --balance-weight 0.05 --seed 0 --num-workers 0 --output-dir out/neural_impurity_convnet_2026-07-20
protocol.schedule: cosine decay over the fixed 20-epoch horizon
protocol.test_policy: leaf class distributions calibrated on MNIST train labels; canonical MNIST test evaluated once after fixed-horizon training

criteria.gini: sample-weighted CART Gini impurity across differentiable leaves
criteria.entropy: sample-weighted normalized Shannon entropy across differentiable leaves
criteria.cross_entropy: standard per-example supervised classifier control using the same convolutional trunk

conclusion: Pure differentiable leaf impurity learns non-collapsed visual partitions, with Gini outperforming entropy, but it materially trails the matched per-example cross-entropy control. Use impurity as a routing criterion or regularizer in a tree of neural experts, not as the experts' only supervised loss.
